name: Nim
needs: Nim 1.6 or newer and nasm and ld (Linux x86-64) or as and ld (Linux ARM64)
notes: The shared library is loaded at run time, so it must be findable: run from this folder with `LD_LIBRARY_PATH=.` (as above) or install it in a system library path.
`read` returns at most 4096 frames per call.
files: demo: decodes the test files and prints checksums
